Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
Just checking, but since the Blood Hunt is "automatically" called, are
Muaziz, Samat, people diablerizing March Halcyon, etc, still immune
to its effects? Lithrac's controller still have extra two votes?
Can Absolution of the Diabolist still be played?
Etc etc for all cards which refer to "if a bloodhunt is called", or
whether or not it can be?

I presume yes, but I want to make sure all of these effects are covered.

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Jozxyqk wrote:
>
> Just checking, but since the Blood Hunt is "automatically" called, are
> Muaziz, Samat, people diablerizing March Halcyon, etc, still immune
> to its effects?

A blood hunt that cannot be called is not called. Card text overrides
the rules.

> Lithrac's controller still have extra two votes?

Yes.

> Can Absolution of the Diabolist still be played?

Yes.

> Etc etc for all cards which refer to "if a bloodhunt is called", or
> whether or not it can be?

The cards that are played if/when a blood hunt is called can be
called if/when the blood hunt is called.

The cards that prohibit the blood hunt from being called prohibit
the blood hunt from being called.

> I presume yes, but I want to make sure all of these effects are covered.

Right.
